content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. NITW/CED/TP/NHAI/02-JRF/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NIT Warangal notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./ B.Tech in Civil Engineering with First class/Division; ME/M.Tech in Transportation Engineering with First Class/Division; Desirable: GATE Qualified Experience: Desirable: prior knowledge of Analytical Modelling Techniques and Traffic simulation models; proficient in behaviour modelling, good analytical ability, competency in writing skills; R-Programming Skills, Python, GIS etc. Age limit: Maximum 30 years Other conditions: Selected candidates are expected to register for the Ph.D. degree at NIT Warangal. Desirable: GATE Qualified Prior knowledge of Analytical Modelling Techniques Prior knowledge of Traffic simulation models Proficient in behaviour modelling, good analytical ability and competency in writing skills R-Programming Skills, Python, GIS etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration 3 years Position is purely temporary and liable for termination based on performance Third-year fellowship of Rs 42,000 per month based on performance

content_sections.heading: How Will NIT Warangal Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: List of eligible candidates announced on institute website and intimated through email Interview (Online/ Offline) for shortlisted candidate List of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and intimated through email Shortlisted candidate will have to attend the interview (Online/ Offline) No TA/DA will be paid for attending interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Completed application form Brief resume/curriculum vitae Copies of certificates and marks memo All supporting documents/marks memos

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates with M.E/M.Tech/M.Planing with GATE Qualified and Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering Technology/B.Planning are eligible for PhD registration subject to institute rules Contact: Dr. B Raghuram Kadali, Phone +91 870 2464251, Mobile +91 9912245124

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for JRF.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 15 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship Rs 37,000 per month for the first two years and Rs 42,000 per month in the third year, based on performance.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering with First class/Division; ME/M.Tech in Transportation Engineering with First Class/Division; GATE qualified desirable.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates are expected to register for the Ph.D. degree at NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: List of eligible candidates announced on institute website and intimated through email. Interview (Online/ Offline) for shortlisted candidate. List of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and intimated through email. Shortlisted candidate will have to attend the interview (Online/ Offline).

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration 3 years. Position is purely temporary and liable for termination based on performance. Third-year fellowship of Rs 42,000 per month based on performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: NIT Warangal, Telangana.
